name: Copper circlet
description: A band of polished wood bound in copper at both edges and studded round, with a pointed copper plaque that rests on the brow. It serves as a focus for spellcasting.
notes: Standing on its lower edge, front on +z: an oak band 170 mm across and 25 mm tall with copper rims, eleven studs and a pointed plaque inset with wood at the front. The ring encloses air. `mana_focus` is a spell-focus quality and a new quality name; Deadvox has no magic yet. Slot `hair`, the slot headbands use, so it can sit under a hat; `head` would clash with helmets. The silver circlet shares this model with its own finishes. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Dragonhide backpack
description: A squared black backpack of thick reptile hide, its front pocket covered in rows of hard raised scutes, closed under a deep strapped lid with buckles of carved bone.
notes: Standing, front toward the iso view: black hide body, lid and side pockets, a red-brown back pad, shoulder straps and hip belt (`leather-chestnut`), charcoal scutes on the front pocket and bone buckles; 360 mm wide and 520 mm tall. Point: lid straps are the two straps down the front of the lid. The model stands at its real size. The hide is `hide-dragon-black`; protection is a guess above plain leather. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Large dragonhide backpack
description: A big squared backpack of thick black reptile hide, cut for a broad back, its front pocket covered in hard raised scutes and its lid held by bone-buckled straps.
notes: The dragonhide backpack's builder made larger: 440 mm wide and 640 mm tall, in the same finishes. Point: lid straps are the two straps down the front of the lid. The model stands at its real size. The name says it is the large one. The hide is `hide-dragon-black`; protection is a guess above plain leather. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Dragonhide boots
description: Tall boots of supple black reptile hide with a turned-down cuff and two bone-buckled straps round each shaft.
notes: A standing pair, 290 mm long and 300 mm tall, toes on +z: black hide feet and shafts, charcoal soles, red-brown toe rands, cuffs and straps (`leather-chestnut`, so the hide boots read apart from the scale boots), bone buckles on the outer sides. The bounding box of a standing pair takes in the air between and round the boots. The hide is `hide-dragon-black`; protection is a guess above plain leather. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Oversized dragonhide boots
description: Huge boots of black reptile hide, cut wide and deep for feet too big or too strange for ordinary footwear, strapped round the shaft with bone buckles.
notes: The dragonhide boots' builder made larger: a standing pair 360 mm long and 360 mm tall in the same finishes. The bounding box of a standing pair takes in the air between and round the boots. The hide is `hide-dragon-black`; protection is a guess above plain leather. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Dragonscale boots
description: Black hide boots armoured from toe to knee in overlapping rows of glossy black scales.
notes: A standing pair, 300 mm long and 300 mm tall, toes on +z: stepped scale lames over the foot alternating with charcoal hide, and the shaft ringed with proud scale rows over charcoal hide bands, a scale collar at the top. The bounding box of a standing pair takes in the air between and round the boots. The scales and the collar take glossy `chitin-black`; the hide showing between the scale rows is `leather-charcoal` so the scales read apart from it, and the shaft is `hide-dragon-black`; protection is a guess above plain leather. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Dragonscale gauntlets
description: Heavy black hide gauntlets with wide flared cuffs, the backs and fingers covered in rows of overlapping glossy scales.
notes: Laid flat side by side, backs up, fingers to +z, 300 mm from cuff to fingertip: black hide gloves with scale rows over the back and fingers, a scale knuckle ridge and flared cuffs 110 mm long bound in red-brown `leather-chestnut`. The scales take glossy `chitin-black` against the matte hide. The hide is `hide-dragon-black`; protection is a guess above plain leather. Slot `hands`, as earlier glove batches use.
